newsitem.title: HONG KONG: AlliedSignal boosts ties with China's AVIC.
newsitem.headline: AlliedSignal boosts ties with China's AVIC.

text.p: AlliedSignal Aerospace said on Thursday it planned to expand its collaborative efforts with state-owned Aviation Industries of China (AVIC) to tap the international aviation industry.

AlliedSignal said it would sign a joint charter/business plan with AVIC for collaboration on engine systems and accessories, which will consider establishing a mechanism to help in the development and sourcing engine systems products.
The company said it will also sign a feasibility report with Shanghai Avionics Co outlining the potential of a possible joint venture in avionics.

AlliedSignal noted its current joint venture with AVIC to manufacture environmental control systems at Nanjing for commercial aircraft had received the necessary government approval and was expected to begin production next year.
The two companies also plan other affiliations and collaborations to leverage the strong positions both have in the Chinese market and the aerospace industry, it said.
